meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 会把指定群组变成持久 wiki 知识库：创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录，生成 index.md、log.md，并改写群组 CLAUDE.md，让它按采集、查询、检查维护知识库。
howto.when: 当你说「add wiki」「wiki」「knowledge base」等关键词，或想给某个 NanoClaw 群组加持久知识库时触发。

say.text: 我想建专属 wiki 群组，用完整三层架构，每周做一次 wiki 检查
say.note: 它会问清群组、来源类型与 lint 周期

say.text: 把这个 PDF 加进 wiki，逐个处理，别批量读
say.note: 它按单文件逐篇采集并更新各 wiki 页面

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a chosen NanoClaw group into a persistent wiki: it creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, writes index.md and log.md, and edits the group's CLAUDE.md so the agent maintains the wiki via ingest, query and lint.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add wiki", "wiki" or "knowledge base", or ask to add a persistent knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group, and explain the LLM Wiki idea first.
say_en.note: It reads llm-wiki.md and summarizes the idea

say_en.text: Make a dedicated wiki group with the full three-layer setup and weekly checks.
say_en.note: It asks about group, sources and lint schedule

say_en.text: Add this PDF to the wiki, one file at a time.
say_en.note: It ingests each file individually and updates pages
